title: Words of the Wise Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Words of the Wise Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Proverbs Bible crossword: trust in the LORD, the soft answer, the ant, and the beginning of wisdom. Free KJV puzzles on iPhone and iPad.
prose: Proverbs is a book of one-line arguments, and a surprising number of them have become ordinary English: a soft answer turneth away wrath, pride goeth before destruction, go to the ant thou sluggard. Words of the Wise makes a grid of the sayings themselves.
Because each proverb is self-contained, the clues can quote one and leave a word out — which is a very direct way to learn them. The closing verse is the one most people who know a proverb know.

verseText: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
